fields.why: Three nativity/residence groups are compared by a year-by-group interaction score test, side by side in 2017, and as a margin of the Table 1 chi-square; four age groups are also a margin of that chi-square.
Nativity with years of U.S. residence (3 groups) and age (4 groups) are the SPDs with 3 or more levels; region is geography, not an SPD.

Rule 4 names an interaction of time trends across 3+ SPD groups as groupwise; the Table 1 chi-square across years has the SPD as a margin (rule 6: omnibus). The flag on entry 1 is a false positive: the 2017 contrast (49% vs 58%, 59%) carries no test, and the chi-square belongs to the year-by-composition table.

brief_issues: Whether a year-by-SPD interaction with 3 SPD levels is 'interaction' or 'model joint test' is settled only by rule 4's example; the assessment definition's 'two dimensions' wording could be read as two SPDs.
